reviews.text: Andrea worked with me and my dog on crate training, recall, sit , stay and building confidence in play and appropriate rewards. She gave me constructive feedback and was quick to follow up with any questions I had. Thank you Andrea and team!

Andrea and her team are incredible. I highly recommend them for both dog walking and Andrea for training. My dog (and I) were only trained by Andrea and he is now an incredibly well behaved dog. We continue to train together in group sessions (that Job of Calm has) and I will definitely be working together on other areas of training with Andrea to improve his skill set. My dog has the most incredible meet and greet and is very calm and waits prior to meeting anyone. Thanks Job of Calm!!!

So happy with Andrea! She helped us work with our very anxious and reactive puppy when we felt at the end of our rope on how to help him. Thanks to her training he has bloomed incredibly. It's like we have a new dog in so many ways!

She stands out for being completely open to finding methods that the dog responds to rather than forcing one path.

Cannot thank her enough!

Andrea helped so much with leash reactivity. We continue to attend group training sessions when we can as the reminders and practice help so much for our daily walks. Our dog loves the group sessions.

I’ve really enjoyed working with Andrea. Our pup, Lucy, is just entering into her boundary-testing adolescent phase and I wanted to make sure we were set up well for her.

Andrea helped me establish boundaries in a way that made sense for both me and Lucy, grew our relationship, and left me with much more hope for the future than when we had started.

I learned how to improve my body language and way of speaking to provide more clarity for Lucy going forward. I learned how to properly use the tools we had (crate, tug toys and leash) to encourage the calm we so desperately wanted to establish.

When we started training, Lucy was demanding nipping at us almost constantly, lunging on leash during walks and ‘pay me attention’ barking at anyone who paused in front of our house.

Andrea trained me so I could hold my boundaries in a positive, calm way. After using her methods and consistent practice, Lucy’s demand nipping has almost disappeared, she is relaxing much better than she ever has before, is on her way to developing a good calm down routine (I see much less barking in her future!), and is slowly but steadily making great strides in her walking manners.

I feel like I have the right tools in my toolbox going forward, and will keep practicing my way into a calm existence with my beautiful furry friend ♥️.

Thanks so much Andrea! I look forward to working with you again when the next big questions come up!

We can’t say enough great things about Andrea! My wife and I came to her as first-time owners of a bigger, more energetic dog than we’d ever had before, and honestly, we needed guidance. Andrea was fantastic. She didn’t just train our puppy; she trained us, giving us the confidence and tools to set our whole family up for success. If you’re navigating puppyhood and feeling a little in over your head, Andrea is exactly who you want in your corner. Highly recommend!

I’m beyond grateful I found Job of Calm. Andrea is an exceptional trainer - smart, intuitive, and adaptable. The training sessions are really impactful and helped me and my rescue pup a ton. Andrea’s team of dog walkers are also incredibly professional and kind. Highly recommend.
Andrea is amazing and I cannot recommend her highly enough!

I started working with Andrea to train my dog Duke. I adopted him as an adult, and he is big, strong, and reactive, so I needed help managing that.

Andrea totally changed the way we navigated the world — she was instrumental in helping me figure out how to enjoy time with my dog and fulfill his needs properly.

I went from barely able to walk him, to enjoying our walks & time together immensely thanks to Andrea’s knowledge and guidance.

I would highly recommend her to anybody — and dogs who, like mine, are strong and reactive.

We then started using The Job of Calm for walks as I transitioned from WFH to in-office work. Jess, Andrea, and Emma are all amazing with Duke on his walks. I can rest easy knowing that he’s safe, taken care-of, mentally enriched, and happy in their company! And they always send wonderful photos and updates from the walk, bringing a smile to my work day.

I cannot recommend the job of calm team enough! You will not regret working with them. Not only will they help with problems or structure, they will change the way you exist alongside your dog.

H

We’ve had such a great experience with The Job Of Calm! Andrea is absolutely amazing — she’s helped us navigate so many aspects of working with our Aussie pup. Through the one-on-one sessions, we’ve built a stronger relationship with our dog, addressed specific behaviours, and discovered new ways to support his unique personality and breed needs.

We recently started the group sessions as well, and both we and Loco are loving them! Andrea introduced us to agility and other fun activities that keep him engaged and challenged. We can’t recommend The Job Of Calm enough — Andrea truly understands dogs and their people.

Andrea is awesome. My dog, Remy, and I just finished four sessions with her, and from the very first session, it was clear she understood him right away and also the challenges I needed help with. Her calm and clear approach really resonated with me and in each session she equipped me with new tools to work with Remy. I left each session excited to work with him further and to put her guidance into practice.

There's still a good amount of work I need to do on my own — training never ends :) — but just through the four sessions, I see a ton of improvement in a few key areas I was struggling with. I would absolutely work with her again and would not hesitate to recommend her to anybody looking for a trainer.

Photo of Remy working on "place" following one of our sessions.

We have had nothing but great results from working with Andrea. She is so knowledgeable about dog psychology, your dogs unique needs, and how to train your dog for the life you want. From our private sessions she has helped us take our mini goldendoodle puppy’s confidence (and ours) and abilities to a whole new level. We can’t recommend her enough!

The five star reviews don’t lie, Andrea with the job of calm helped not only my dog but me understand my dogs needs and wants to keep training her! I’m just four sessions I saw a drastic improvement and gave me notes to work with at home to continue our training. Thanks so much! Couldn’t recommend this company enough.
